about.title: Tso eŋu
about.intro: {project} nye dzidzime yeye ƒe peer-to-peer nudede nuwo dɔwɔnu si wotu kple decentralized mɔnu yeyewo dzi. Eblea zazã bɔbɔe kple decentralized ɖoɖo blibo nu, eye wòkpɔa egbɔ be wotsɔa nudede nuwo dedea ɖe edzi kple kakaɖedzi evɔ titina ƒe ŋusẽ aɖeke mahiã o. Dɔwɔnu sia nye open source, woɖe egome le {license} te.

decentralized.title: Decentralized network blibo
decentralized.description: Server titina aɖeke meli o, gbeɖoɖoanyi ɖeka aɖeke meli o. Zãlawo dia nudzɔdzɔwo eye woɖea wo tẽ tso wo nɔewo gbɔ, evɔ titina ƒe nuŋlɔɖi, tracker alo database aɖeke mahiã o.

accessControl.title: Mɔɖoɖo si wotrɔna ɖe nudzɔdzɔ ŋu
accessControl.description: Ame sia ame ate ŋu atu eya ŋutɔ ƒe network kple eya ŋutɔ ƒe sewo femaxee. Le network ɖe sia ɖe me la, woɖo zãlawo ƒe ɖoɖowo: nutɔ, dɔdzikpɔla, nudzɔla, moderator kple kpɔla. Ènye ame si dzraa ɖoɖo ɖe ame siwo ate ŋu atsɔ nudzɔdzɔwo, alé ŋku ɖe wo ŋu eye woaɖe wo agbalẽa ŋu.

ui.title: Zãzã si dze nyuie
ui.description: Media center zãzã si dza eye wòɖoa ŋkume na televizionwo, computer kple mobile mɔ̃wo. Tata bɔbɔe le keyboard, mouse, gamepad alo remote dzi. Zãla siwo ƒo nu sɔŋ la ate ŋu azã dɔwɔnua abe headless data server ene to command line zãzã me.

dataFormat.title: Data ƒe nɔnɔme si amegbetɔ ate ŋu axlẽ
dataFormat.description: LISH data ƒe nɔnɔme wotu kple JSON dzi, eye wònana wòle bɔbɔe be woawɔe, woaxlẽe eye woase egɔme. Tsɔ wò nudzɔdzɔwo dzra le metadata si dze nyuie eye wòle nutopaƒe me, esi ame sia ame ate ŋu akpɔe.

security.title: Bebenu kple dedienɔnɔ
security.description: Wotsɔ peer-to-peer ƒomedodowo katã ɣla, esi nana wò data nye bebenu nu le ɖoɖo me. Zãlawo ate ŋu azã VPN tsɔ aɣla wo ɖokuiwo geɖe wu. {project} dea bubu wò bebenu ŋu tso eƒe wɔwɔ me.

crossPlatform.title: Mɔ vovovowo dzi zazã
crossPlatform.description: Dɔwɔnua li na Windows, Linux kple macOS. Zãe le mɔ ɖe sia ɖe si nèlɔ̃ dzi.

download.title: Ɖe agbalẽa
download.description: Xɔ {project} na wò mɔ. Ɖeɖe ɖe sia ɖe nye femaxee eye wònye open source.
